editorial.blurb: Don't let the hotel location fool you—Thai Spoon and Sushi delivers genuinely delicious, flavorful Thai and Japanese food with the kind of attentive service that keeps people coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask for extra cucumber salad on the side if you order the Tofu Satay; reviewers loved it enough to want a whole bowl, and chili sauce is always on the table.
